name: medquery-app
description: MedQuery phone app (Android) built with Capacitor from the same code as the website in ../site

scripts.sync: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.android: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: node scripts/build-web.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
